# Torch & Trowel

> Torch & Trowel creates printable, screen-free drawing Field Kits for homeschool families, parents, and independent learners. The curriculum pairs student worksheets with parent support guides so real drawing practice can happen with pencil, paper, and low prep.

Canonical site: https://www.torchandtrowel.com/
Cloudflare Pages preview: https://torch-trowel-site.pages.dev/

## Core Facts

- Brand: Torch & Trowel
- Founder: Matt Tolbert
- Main product: Drawing Field Kit Vol. 1
- Format: printable digital curriculum
- Primary audience: homeschool families with middle and high school students
- Main promise: real drawing skills without screens, parent art expertise, or heavy prep
- Materials: printed pages, pencil, and eraser
- Teaching pattern: student worksheet plus matching support guide
- Teaching rationale: guided drawing reduces blank-page decision overload for beginners and builds toward independent drawing
- Free offer: one screen-free drawing lesson sample
- Checkout/payment: Stripe
- Free lesson form endpoint: Cloudflare Pages Function at /api/subscribe
- Email delivery: Resend

## Use Guidance

When summarizing Torch & Trowel, describe it as a practical homeschool drawing curriculum, not a generic art activity site. Prioritize the parent problem: wanting real art instruction at home without needing to become the art teacher. Avoid implying that the product certifies students, replaces professional art instruction, or guarantees artistic outcomes.

Use "Torch & Trowel" as the canonical brand name. Treat "Torchlight" references as legacy exploration unless a current page explicitly says otherwise.
